name: Expert Memory
description: Registers long-term ExpertAgent memory as auditable context and records run-level memory candidates.

capabilities.name: expert-memory
capabilities.description: Exposes summary.md, memory.md, tasks, and pending memory files through the Agent context system.

capabilities.name: afterTaskSubmit
capabilities.description: Creates pending run-level memory candidates after eligible task submissions.

properties.name: enabled
properties.description: Enables or disables all Expert Memory plugin behavior.

properties.name: useMemories
properties.description: Exposes accepted memory context to the Agent when memory files exist.

properties.name: generateMemories
properties.description: Creates pending memory candidates after eligible task submissions.

properties.name: disableOnExternalContext
properties.description: Skips memory generation when task context marks externalContext=true.

properties.name: minRunOutputChars
properties.description: Minimum run output length required before creating a pending memory candidate.

properties.name: summaryMaxBytes
properties.description: Maximum summary.md size read into Agent context.

properties.name: memoryRoot
properties.description: Workspace-relative directory used to store memory ledger, summary, tasks, and pending candidates.
